L1.3 a unit that outlives its deadline is stopped by the state read and reported as a timeout
L1.4 a unit does not outlive a controller that is killed
L1.5 a worker unit gets the contract's environment, its scratch directory as working directory, and its own log
L1.6 a unit that was never started is unavailable, empty, and silent to stop
L1.7 the option chooses the launcher; without it only a system with systemctl gets systemd
D4 the state owner's containment checks hold where normalizePath() defaults to backslashes
D4 reading a staged table's metadata leaves no handle or mapping on the file (Windows cannot rename around one)
L2.1 a GUI action runs on a plain worker: one commit, the result read back, a receipt without measurements
L2.2 a failing worker and a worker that tries to commit end as worker_failed, and the head stays
L2.3 a cancellation stops the worker and leaves the head, the history and the action lock as they were
L2.4 a worker past the per-step deadline ends as worker_failed
L2.5 closing the application stops a running worker and releases the project
L2.6 after a controller is killed its worker goes, and a new controller recovers the project and runs an action

L2.8 the plain controller is the calling process: no control group, checked by class, owner and launcher, closed at exit
